fields.name: image
fields.label: Visual Image
fields.description: Cut-out photo (transparent PNG) without the infinity line, the line is drawn by the banner

fields.name: image_position
fields.label: Photo Placement
fields.description: Where the photo sits in the visual area. Left matches the Best Seller slide, Right the family slide in Figma

fields.name: image_curve
fields.label: Show Infinity Curve
fields.description: White infinity line drawn over the photo

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Decorative background. The red-to-blue shade is applied on top automatically.

fields.name: background_mobile
fields.label: Background Image (mobile)
fields.description: Optional: its own background for mobile and tablet (fills the 328 x 400 slide); the one above is used when empty

fields.name: content_text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Heading (use Shift+Enter for a second line) followed by a short description. Without a heading the first paragraph becomes the title

fields.name: content_linkText
fields.label: CTA Text
fields.description: Button label, e.g. Talk to An Expert

fields.name: content_stats
fields.label: Stats
fields.description: Optional, needs the CTA: one figure per line, value in bold, e.g. **27.6%** Growth. With stats the slide uses the stats layout: the photo centre right with the figures around it, the description as the small print beside the button
